## C++ Device

```cpp
template <size_t MaximumMessageBytes = 1024, size_t ReassemblySlots = 2, size_t OutboundFrames = 32, size_t PendingRequests = 8>
class corelib::Device
```

Fixed-storage owner and type-safe facade for one device endpoint.

MaximumMessageBytes Maximum complete PFP message bytes. ReassemblySlots Concurrent fragmented inbound messages. OutboundFrames Frames that may await transport acceptance. PendingRequests Requests that may await application responses.

### `Device`

```cpp
corelib::Device< MaximumMessageBytes, ReassemblySlots, OutboundFrames, PendingRequests >::Device()=default
```

Constructs an uninitialised endpoint with zeroed fixed storage.
